mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tlias.emp (username, name, gender, phone, job, salary, image, entry_date, dept_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{username}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{job}, #{salary}, #{image}, #{entryDate}, #{deptId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select e.*, ee.id as eeId, ee.emp_id as eeEmpId, ee.`begin` as eeBegin, ee.`end` as eeEnd, ee.company as eeCompany, ee.job as eeJob from tlias.emp as e left outer join tlias.emp_expr ee on e.id = ee.emp_id where e.id = #{id};
SELECT id, username, password, name, gender, image, job, salary, entry_date, dept_id, create_time, update_time FROM tlias.emp
